output-size-suspicion (operational / episode)
layer: warm   visibility: local
recorded: 2026-10-06 18:24 · 4m ago

Suspicion: the provider seems to ignore the size parameter — every image
comes back at the same dimensions regardless of what we pass.

arguments.name: output-size-root-cause-settled
arguments.body: The size parameter is honoured by the provider. Three requests at different sizes and the provider's own model page confirmed this. The fixed dimensions came from our side: a default in the client config overwrote the size passed to the request. The earlier suspicion that the provider ignored the parameter was a false alarm.
